access.sensitive_label_filter: Synthetic allowlisted labels only; no secrets, prompts, responses, tensor/KV content or process environments.

decision_rules: A calibration run may be exploratory but requires finite safety limits.
A required unset limit, missing reference, incomplete required fault case, or uncertainty overlapping a limit prevents acceptance pass.
Not applicable requires a reason and owner; missing evidence is not an exemption.
A synthetic pass cannot set real_verification to passed.
Changing a profile or acceptance limit requires a new manifest revision and reevaluation.
null_meaning: Unset/not agreed; never unlimited, zero, automatically not applicable, or a pass.

run.baseline_and_pairing_method: Compare against hand-checkable invented expected states, never a real inference baseline.
run.durability_boundary: No persistence acceptance in this case unless separately declared.
run.environment_description: Local synthetic reference only; no real engine/hardware access.
fault_scenarios: Worker host is unknown, not the frontend host; timing distributions are not merged as interchangeable measurements.
run.measurement_window: Declared virtual case window; wall-clock scenario cap 60 seconds.
run.offered_metric_volume_and_cardinality: Up to 64 series per variant; at most 32 invented entities; actual fixture manifest pending.

reference_truth.negative_expected_result: Worker host is unknown, not the frontend host; timing distributions are not merged as interchangeable measurements.
reference_truth.positive_expected_result: An explicit source counting boundary reports ten logical requests, not twenty; each raw series retains its producer.

run.source_to_subject_identity_evidence: Invented explicit identities and validity windows; missing relations stay unknown.
run.warmup: No real workload; virtual warmup only if later specified.
run.workload_shape: Frontend and backend observations referring to the same ten logical requests; frontend also reports a worker whose location evidence is missing.
